firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently traveled to Scotland, or somewhere near it, goes first.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: Players then alternate turns, starting by playing a Clan card.
In the Clanfehde multi-round variant, the players alternate who starts each round.
The rulebook does not define how close to Scotland a visit must be.
